# Hejmdal Privathospital Odense

Hejmdal Privathospital Odense is a private hospital department ("afdeling") in Odense, Denmark, that appears in the Danish ADHD quality database (ADHD-databasen) as one of many clinical units assessed against national quality indicators for ADHD diagnostic workups in children and young people [^src1][^src2]. Its defining data point in the corpus is a reported 0 percent fulfillment of Indicator 2b, the measure tracking how often a manualised diagnostic interview or environmental (school/home) observation is carried out during an ADHD assessment [^src1][^src2].

This result places Hejmdal Privathospital Odense at the extreme low end of a national landscape described in the source document as showing "betydelig underopfyldelse" (significant under-fulfillment) of the 90 percent development target for Indicator 2b, with the national average sitting at only 51 percent [^src1][^src2]. The broader chunk context notes that Region Syddanmark — the region in which Odense is located — shows a "nedadgående trend" (downward trend) on these indicators, while other regions such as Region Midtjylland show positive development, underscoring wide regional variation in ADHD assessment quality across Denmark [^src1][^src2]. The same reporting period, spanning 01.04.2024 to 31.03.2025, also covers Indicator 3 (diagnostic conferences with specialist physicians), which nationally reached only 27 percent fulfillment, and Indicator 2a (clinical environmental observation), where departments such as Vejle and Aabenraa achieved 100 percent, in sharp contrast to Hejmdal Privathospital Odense's result [^src1][^src2]. In response to criticism of the existing indicators, the steering group ("styregruppen") has revised both Indicator 2b and Indicator 3 to better reflect current clinical practice and to allow for grading of efforts based on case complexity [^src1][^src2].

Beyond its two identical data-table appearances, the corpus provides no further narrative detail, organizational relationships, or additional claims about Hejmdal Privathospital Odense.
